hero_eyebrow: Free and open source · Windows · macOS · Linux
hero_title: Volleyball scouting at the speed of the game
hero_content: scout4all is built to cut the time it takes to record events while scouting, with an interaction designed mainly for the keyboard, but usable with a mouse or other devices too. The data you collect let you check statistics and analyze performance, during and after the match.
video_label: A few rallies scouted from the keyboard: reception, attack, serve with its zone, dig and counter-attack.

highlights.title: Zones of play
highlights.content: Serve, reception, attack, dig and block zones. Recording of the block composition.

highlights.title: DataVolley files
highlights.content: Import .dvw matches, with their zones, and analyse them next to your own.

highlights.title: PDF report
highlights.content: A scoresheet-style report of the match, ready to print or share with the team.

highlights.title: Your keys
highlights.content: Every event, evaluation and set type can be bound to the key you prefer.

highlights.title: Five languages
highlights.content: English, Italian, Portuguese, Polish and Japanese.

highlights.title: Always up to date
highlights.content: At startup it checks for a new version and, if you agree, installs it and restarts.
